title.narrative: Recovery and Rehabilitation of Dairy Sector in Bek a Valley and Hermel-Akkar Uplands

description.narrative: The aim of this project is to enable recovery-rehabilitation and assistance to the livelihoods of 300 vulnerable livestock keepers in Central Bek a Valley, North Akkar and Hermel-Akkar Highlands who are resource poor, with little or no assistance and currently unable to keep up with the highly competitive animal production sub-sector. An additional 300 farmers will draw indirect benefits from the project through veterinary and artificial insemination services as well as training sessions. The proposed project is also aiming to provide alternative income-generating activities to the poorest farmers with the highest level of socio-economic deprivation in Hermel-Akkar highlands in order to reduce their dependence on illicit crops.
